verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference under /reference/ and a first-party Postman collection plus a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which together let users run example requests. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or has in-browser runnable examples, and running the collection requires Postman. Missing for 10: documented in-browser try-it console in the reference, explicit runnable code samples per endpoint, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: ComplyAdvantage offers a Postman collection to help you on your integration journey... you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema
parsed OpenAPI 3.0.3. The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
This endpoint returns the monitor status for a single customer.
